title: Register with RetirePath Virginia or certify a retirement plan exemption
description: Employers in business at least two years with 25 or more eligible employees and no qualified plan must register or certify an exemption; the first deadline was February 15, 2024. One source says smaller tiers follow (15 to 24 employees in 2026, 5 to 12 in 2027). Penalty of up to $200 per eligible employee a year.

appliesWhen.description: 25 or more employees in the state

exemptions: Employers that sponsor a qualified retirement plan (they still certify the exemption)

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file or register.

penalty.note: Up to $200 per eligible employee a year.
